channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Donald Trump de olho na eleição brasileira - O Assunto #1747
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has shown increasing interest in Brazil's 2026 elections, sharing an article that frames Brazil as a 'test' for conservative resurgence in Latin America. His previously praised relationship with Lula, described as having 'excellent chemistry,' has deteriorated after the G-7, where Trump said he 'doesn't think about' and 'doesn't care' for Lula. The White House has since imposed new tariffs on Brazilian goods and labeled CV and PCC as terrorist organizations, intensifying pressure on Lula's government. Trump may publicly endorse Flávio Bolsonaro, while Lula seeks to leverage fears of U.S. intervention to bolster his political position.

item.title: Flávio responde Michelle e fala em ‘gesto não correspondido’; ‘Foco é livrar Brasil de Lula e do PT’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro responded to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro in an open letter, denying that he humiliated her during a phone call and stating his sole focus is to free Brazil from Lula and the PT. He said he had tried to invite her to a meeting with conservative female leaders, but she did not answer calls or messages, which he described as an 'unreciprocated gesture'.

item.title: Políticos comemoram vitória da seleção brasileira sobre a da Escócia
item.description: Brazilian politicians celebrated Brazil's 3-0 victory over Scotland in the 2026 World Cup, using the match to advance their electoral campaigns. Flávio Bolsonaro praised Neymar, Lula shared a photo with allies wearing the national team jersey, and other pre-candidates such as Haddad, Caiado, and Zema used the event for political messaging, including memes and references to campaign promises.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro veem Michelle em campanha pelo comando do bolsonarismo
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro believe Michelle Bolsonaro is seeking to weaken his current position to strengthen her own future influence within the bolsonarist movement, particularly in the post-Lula era. They interpret her statements as an early battle over Jair Bolsonaro’s political legacy, with her positioning herself as the most loyal heir. Originating from a rift over local endorsements in Ceará, the conflict has evolved into a national struggle for leadership of the Bolsonaro political franchise, with an eye on 2030.

item.title: Vídeo de Michelle sobre Flávio: entenda a crise e o racha na família Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro claimed she was humiliated and mistreated by Flávio Bolsonaro during a phone call after criticizing the PL's alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará. She stated they have not spoken since the end of 2025 and denied her testimony aimed to replace him as presidential candidate, emphasizing her priority is caring for her family and husband, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula se diz 'consternado' com situação da Venezuela e Trump promete ajuda ao país; veja repercussão entre chefes de Estados
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expressed concern over the Venezuela earthquakes and directed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to assess the situation and potential aid, reaffirming Brazil's support for interim President Delcy Rodríguez's government. The United States also offered solidarity, with Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau announcing mobilization of search-and-rescue teams, medical supplies, and humanitarian aid, while Donald Trump expressed solidarity on social media. No Brazilian citizens have been identified among the victims, according to Itamaraty, which provided emergency contacts for Brazilians in Venezuela.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro irá a evento na Argentina com Javier Milei, diz site
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will attend a conference organized by the Aliados de Israel Foundation in Buenos Aires from June 28 to 30, alongside Argentine President Javier Milei. The event will gather legislators and authorities from across Latin America, and Flávio has requested a personal meeting with Milei, underscoring the growing alignment between the Bolsonaro family and Argentina’s libertarian leader.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Michelle gravou vídeo após não retornar mensagem dele e afirma estar de 'coração aberto'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro publicly apologized to Michelle Bolsonaro after she released videos accusing him of mistreatment and humiliation amid disagreements over 2026 election agreements. He said he tried to contact her personally, left a message that went unanswered, and emphasized his actions were rooted in respect for the family and a mission designated by Jair Bolsonaro, keeping the invitation for dialogue 'with an open heart'.

item.title: Entenda em 5 pontos as controvérsias e lacunas em falas de Gilmar no Roda Viva
item.description: In an interview on Roda Viva, Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes criticized Minister André Mendonça for his role as rapporteur in the Master case, expressed dissatisfaction with Court President Edson Fachin's handling of the debate on the Supreme Court's ethics code, and was questioned about the transparency of magistrates' earnings.

item.title: O grande problema da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro para além do caso Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's main electoral challenge for 2026 is no longer the Master case, but his inability to mobilize key bolsonarist allies. According to Murilo Hidalgo of Paraná Pesquisas, the absence of Tarcísio de Freitas, Nikolas Ferreira, and Michelle Bolsonaro is eroding his support in strategic strongholds, especially in the Southeast. Michelle's distancing, worsened by personal disagreements, represents a major loss of political capital for his campaign.

item.title: PT entra em consenso por Marília Campos na disputa ao governo de MG
item.description: The PT has nominated Marília Campos, former mayor of Contagem, as its consensus candidate for the Minas Gerais gubernatorial race in 2026, based on her strongest polling performance. The decision was formalized in a meeting with Lula and state party leaders at the Palácio da Alvorada, aiming to build a competitive ticket in a key state for Lula’s re-election bid. Although she is currently a Senate pre-candidate, the party is urging her to shift to the gubernatorial race after other potential candidates, including Rodrigo Pacheco and Gabriel Azevedo, withdrew.

item.title: Valdemar reage a vídeo de Michelle sobre Flávio: “Vamos ter paciência”
item.description: PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto downplayed the political impact of a video in which former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stating the party would exercise patience to resolve internal tensions and that it would not harm Flávio’s presidential campaign. Michelle said she felt betrayed and humiliated by Flávio after criticizing the PL’s alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará, claiming he told her to stay out of party decisions.

item.title: Haddad afirma que decisão sobre chapa em São Paulo sairá nesta quinta
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) announced he will formalize by Thursday the invitations to compose his ticket for the São Paulo governorship and Federal Senate, following a meeting with Lula and Alckmin. Former ministers Marina Silva, Simone Tebet, and Márcio França are being considered for vice-governor or senator, with Haddad making the final decision. The ticket is strategic for Lula, aiming to accelerate the announcement of his re-election bid and counter Tarcísio de Freitas’ influence in Brazil’s second-largest electoral college.

item.title: Nunes Marques convoca sessão no TSE para julgamento de 28 processos
item.description: TSE President Justice Kassio Nunes Marques called an extraordinary virtual session to judge 28 cases involving negative early election propaganda for the 2026 elections. Ministers will vote between 0h and 23h59 today on PL representations regarding posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the 'Carne e Unha' operation and statements by Lula and Dario Durigan, as well as a Brazil Hope Federation challenge against Mario Frias' posts on lowering the age of criminal responsibility.

item.title: Governo Lula critica ida de Flávio aos EUA e cita “traidores”
item.description: The Lula government criticized opposition sectors, calling them 'traitors of the Fatherland' for blaming the Executive for U.S. commercial sanctions. The statement came after Senator Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his participation in a USTR hearing against the 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, accusing the government of incompetence in protecting exports. Itamaraty stated the tariffs stem from an attempt at external interference in Brazil's judiciary and that opponents owe the country an apology for the damages caused.

item.title: Silas Malafaia responde a Michelle Bolsonaro após expor briga com Flávio
item.description: Evangelical leader Silas Malafaia, allied with the Bolsonaro family, responded to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro after she publicly exposed a feud with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Malafaia said he would respond only with two Bible passages, avoiding direct confrontation. The full article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: ‘Nada, nem ninguém me aborrece’, diz Flávio após Michelle falar que foi humilhada
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said 'nothing and nobody' bothers him, after Michelle Bolsonaro accused him of humiliating her in videos posted earlier. He made the comment during a pre-World Cup match livestream, wearing a Neymar mask alongside his wife, stating he plans regular livestreams and feels more confident and prepared for his presidential pre-candidacy, a mission he said was given to him by his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Vini Jr. comemora volta de Neymar à seleção brasileira: 'Momento muito importante para nós'
item.description: Neymar returned to the Brazilian national team after 981 days, coming on as a substitute in Brazil's 3-0 win over Scotland in the 2026 World Cup group stage. Vinicius Junior praised Neymar's return as emotionally and technically vital, and was named man of the match, extending his direct goal involvement to five in the tournament.

item.title: Vídeo de Michelle divide opiniões entre bolsonaristas
item.description: A video by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, in which she claims she was disrespected by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, has sparked division among Bolsonaro allies regarding the risks this episode poses to the senator’s presidential pre-candidacy. While some seek to downplay the incident, others acknowledge its potential to harm unity and the group’s image.

item.title: Erika Hilton foi a candidata estreante com maior volume de recursos em 2022
item.description: Erika Hilton was the first-time candidate for the Chamber of Deputés who received the highest volume of financial resources from PSOL in the 2022 elections, according to TSE financial reports. This highlights her prominence within the party and fuels internal debate about priorities and support for new candidates.

item.title: “Cadê o filho do Lula?”, questiona Eduardo em jogo do Brasil
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) posted a photo at Miami Stadium in Florida after Brazil's 3-0 win over Scotland in the World Cup. In the image, he wears a shirt reading 'Bolsonaro livre' and provocatively asks, 'Where is Lula's son?'. The post was shared on social media and reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Saída de Jaques Wagner do governo divide oposição, que alterna entre ataques e tom cauteloso
item.description: The resignation of Jaques Wagner as Senate government leader sparked division within the opposition: while a hardline faction of the Liberal Party pushes to attack the government, framing Wagner’s exit as an 'admission of guilt' and attempting to tie Lula to the Banco Master scandal, a more cautious faction prefers silence, waiting for the investigation’s developments and leveraging the World Cup moment to avoid premature confrontation.

item.title: Após reunião com Lula, Haddad diz que definirá chapa na 5ª feira
item.description: Fernando Haddad announced he will finalize his São Paulo gubernatorial ticket by Thursday following a meeting with Lula and Alckmin. He stated that Márcio França, Marina Silva, and Simone Tebet have made themselves available for vice-governor or Senate seats, leaving the choice to him. Haddad expressed honor at their confidence and pledged to formalize the invitation by tomorrow.

item.title: 'Ele está sabendo de tudo', diz Michelle, referindo-se a Jair Bolsonaro, em vídeo com críticas a aliados do ex-presidente; vídeo
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro released a video accusing former President Jair Bolsonaro of being aware of the attacks and lies she has endured, allegedly coming from his allies. She harshly criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming he mistreated and disrespected her in a phone call after she opposed the PL’s negotiations with Ciro Gomes. Michelle also stated that Flávio’s circle treats her as ignorant, but insists she 'knows more' about politics than they think, signaling a deepening rift within the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: A reação de Flávio Bolsonaro após Michelle expor desavença
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said nothing could bother him on a day of Brazil’s World Cup match, hours after Michelle Bolsonaro exposed family tensions in a video, accusing him of disrespect and trying to sideline her from party decisions. She said she was treated like an idiot and withdrew after a harsh phone call. Flávio kept a light tone, focusing on football and avoiding direct comment on the conflict.

item.title: Aliados veem vídeo de Michelle como exposição desnecessária de divergências com Flávio e temem prejuízo à campanha
item.description: Allies of pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro expressed concern over a video by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro criticizing him publicly, fearing the family conflict’s exposure could damage his appeal among female voters, particularly evangelicals and PL Women’s leaders. While party leadership downplays the crisis, saying the party is bigger than individuals, allies like Deputy Zé Trovão called the dispute immature and harmful, distracting from the opposition’s focus during economic and security challenges.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro acusa Flávio de desrespeito e expõe racha familiar
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of disrespect and humiliation during a phone call, exposing a rift within the Bolsonaro family. She shared the account in a video posted on social media, stating she was treated inadequately by the brother of former president Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: "Ninguém me aborrece", diz Flávio Bolsonaro após vídeo de Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoided commenting on a video in which Michelle Bolsonaro claims he disrespected and humiliated her during a phone call. In a YouTube live stream, he focused on Brazil's World Cup match against Scotland, stating that 'nothing and nobody' would bother him that day. Michelle accused the senator of treating her poorly, questioning her political understanding, and suggesting she stay out of party decisions.

item.title: Vini Jr. ultrapassa números de Ronaldinho Gaúcho e Romário em Copas
item.description: Vini Jr. surpassed Ronaldinho Gaúcho and Romário in goal involvements for the Brazilian national team in World Cups, with eight involvements (5 goals, 3 assists) in just seven matches. He is currently Brazil’s top scorer in the 2026 World Cup and has exceeded the totals of Ronaldinho (6) and Romário (6). Among Brazilian players this century, only Ronaldo, Neymar and Rivaldo have better World Cup numbers than him.

item.title: “É dia de jogo, nada nem ninguém me aborrece”, diz Flávio após vídeo de Michelle
item.description: Senator and presidential pré-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) reacted to a video posted by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, in which she accused him of disrespect during an internal political disagreement. He responded that, being 'game day', nothing or nobody bothers him and that he prefers to focus on positive matters. The public exchange highlights growing tensions within the Bolsonarist circle.

item.title: Flávio evita falar de Michelle e diz que nada tira seu bom humor
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro avoided commenting on Michelle Bolsonaro's accusations, stating that his good mood would not be affected by the Brazilian national team playing in the World Cup. Michelle posted Instagram videos claiming she was 'stabbed in the back' and humiliated by Flávio after criticizing the PL's support for Ciro Gomes in a Ceará event. Flávio said what is at stake in Brazil is above any vanity and redirected focus to football.

item.title: Michelle joga um Dark Horse em Flávio Bolsonaro ao dizer que foi apunhalada
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he disrespected and mistreated her, and suggested his pre-candidacy should be 'sent to the electoral hospital', using a metaphor to imply it is weak or nonviable. The remark was delivered calmly but carried significant weight in the family's political dynamics.

item.title: Haddad: definição de vice na chapa em SP será feita até quinta (25)
item.description: Fernando Haddad announced that the decision on his running mate for the São Paulo gubernatorial race will be made by Thursday (June 25). He stated the choice is his responsibility following a meeting with Lula and Márcio França, during which Marina Silva, Simone Tebet, and França themselves offered to run for vice-governor or senator. While the PT prefers França as vice, he has expressed interest in a Senate run, and PSB allies view his gubernatorial bid as a strategic test rather than a viable option.

item.title: Michelle diz que Flávio Bolsonaro a desrespeitou em novo abalo na campanha do senador
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of disrespecting her in a phone call after they disagreed on the PL's electoral strategy. She claims he does not want her support for his 2026 presidential bid, creating a new rift within the family and party alliance.

item.title: Caso Master: Jaques Wagner anuncia afastamento de cargo após operação da PF
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) officially announced his withdrawal from the government leadership in the Senate, following a private meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the Palácio do Planalto. The decision came shortly after developments in Operation Compliance Zero, a Federal Police investigation into alleged irregularities in public contracts. The move aims to safeguard government stability amid mounting political and judicial pressures.

item.title: Após críticas de Michelle, Flávio faz live, mas não a cita diretamente: ‘Hoje, nada me aborrece’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a YouTube live shortly after his stepmother Michelle Bolsonaro released videos criticizing him, though he did not mention her directly, instead framing the stream as a casual pre-match chat ahead of Brazil's game. He emphasized the presence of his wife, Fernanda Bolsonaro, to appeal to female voters ahead of the 2026 elections, and noted a recent meeting with former President Jair Bolsonaro, whom he described as steadfast and guiding his political mission.

item.title: Entenda o conflito no PL do Ceará que levou ao rompimento entre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused Flávio Bolsonaro of mistreatment and disrespect in a phone call following their disagreement over a potential alliance between the PL and Ciro Gomes in Ceará. While Flávio supports Alcides Fernandes for the Senate, Michelle backs Priscila Costa, national vice-president of PL Women, citing her key role in André Fernandes’ Fortaleza mayoral campaign. The rift highlights a deeper split in Bolsonarist circles in Ceará, with the party’s senatorial candidacy to be decided by the end of the July party convention.

item.title: Vídeo de Michelle interrompe tentativa de trégua com Flávio, dizem aliados
item.description: A video of former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro, in which she attacks presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, disrupted an ongoing truce between the two that had been brokered by allies within the PL. The rupture exposes internal party tensions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Após vídeo de Michelle, Flávio Bolsonaro diz que 'ninguém' o aborrece em dia de jogo do Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said nothing or nobody bothers him on a day when Brazil plays in the World Cup, following a video by Michelle Bolsonaro criticating her sons. He announced weekly live streams like his father and confirmed attendance at a conservative event in Argentina. Eduardo Bolsonaro has not yet commented on Michelle's video but posted a photo watching Brazil vs. Scotland.

item.title: Criticado por Michelle, Flávio diz que é dia de jogo e que ninguém o aborrecerá
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro downplayed criticisms from Michelle Bolsonaro, stating he would not be bothered by her as it was match day for Brazil in the World Cup. He avoided controversy, emphasized focusing on positive topics like football, and mentioned visiting his father Jair Bolsonaro, who sent greetings to everyone.

item.title: Michelle diz ter sido “humilhada” por Flávio e que não o procura mais
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro claims she was 'stabbed in the back' and humiliated by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after publicly criticizing the PL’s alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará in 2025. She says Flávio rebuked her over the phone, telling her she didn’t understand politics and should stay out of party decisions, and that they have not spoken since — despite him visiting her home weekly.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro diz que foi humilhada por Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Uma punhalada’; veja vídeo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro revealed she was humiliated by Flávio Bolsonaro in a phone call, describing it as 'a stab in the back,' after he told her to stay out of party decisions and said she didn’t understand politics. The conflict escalated after Michelle publicly criticized the PL Ceará’s alliance with Ciro Gomes, which Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro viewed as disrespectful to former President Jair Bolsonaro. Michelle reaffirmed her opposition to the alliance, citing Ciro’s offensive remarks about the Bolsonaro family and asserting he cannot be trusted by the right.

item.title: Fachin pede análise antes de decidir relatoria de caso “Dark Horse”
item.description: Supreme Court President Justice Edson Fachin requested a technical analysis from the Judiciary Secretariat before assigning a rapporteur to the investigation request linked to the film 'Dark Horse', which alleges irregularities in the financing involving Jair Bolsonaro, his sons, and Banco Master. The rapporteurship is contested between Justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, with the PGR supporting a decision based on formal connections to other investigations. After the analysis, Fachin will decide whether to keep the case with Moraes, transfer it to Mendonça, or assign it by lot among the justices.

item.title: Em resposta a Flávio, Itamaraty diz que ‘traidores da pátria’ devem desculpas pelo tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The Brazilian Foreign Ministry rebutted Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s criticism, stating that the government has actively engaged in the U.S. trade dispute through direct governmental channels, including written defenses and high-level meetings in Washington. It claimed that 'traitors of the Fatherland' should apologize for the U.S. tariffs, linking them to an alleged external interference in Brazil’s justice system. Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, accused the government of inaction and announced his intention to testify at the USTR public hearing in July.

item.title: Crusoé: “Traidores da Pátria não conseguirão reescrever a história”, diz Itamaraty
item.description: The Itamaraty reacted to the possible participation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a USTR public hearing on proposed 25% tariffs on Brazilian imports, stating that 'traitors of the homeland will not be able to rewrite history'. The statement was issued in response to bolsonarist support for the senator’s initiative to influence U.S. trade policy against Brazil.

item.title: Michelle abre guerra nas redes contra Flávio Bolsonaro e tenta influenciar decisão do PL no Ceará: 'Me tratam como idiota'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro publicly criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in Instagram videos, accusing him of mistreating her and dismissing her political support as insignificant during a 2023 family rift over Ceará elections. She stated her actions were always agreed upon with Jair Bolsonaro and described the brothers' criticism as coordinated and aggressive. Michelle sought to influence the PL's decision in Ceará, opposing support for Ciro Gomes.

item.title: ‘Traidores da Pátria’: Itamaraty reage ao pedido de Flávio de participar de reunião nos EUA sobre tarifas
item.description: Brazil's Ministry of Foreign Affairs harshly criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for requesting to participate in a U.S. public hearing on tariffs imposed on Brazilian goods, labeling him and others supporting the measure as 'traitors of the Fatherland'. The Itamaraty stated that such hearings are for private sector and civil society, not foreign government representatives, and demanded an 'apology for the tariffs and the damages caused'. Bolsonaro had said he would oppose the proposed U.S. tariff and advocate for a negotiated solution.

item.title: Itamaraty critica Flávio ir aos EUA tratar de tarifaço: 'Traidor da pátria'
item.description: The Itamaraty (Brazilian Ministry of Foreign Affairs) criticized the possible participation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a U.S. public hearing on American tariffs against Brazilian products, without naming him directly, stating such action would harm national interests. The ministry's statement was seen as a diplomatic rebuke of the senator’s initiative, which aligns with opposition efforts to challenge Brazil’s foreign trade policy. The incident underscores tensions between the executive branch and opposition figures over the management of international trade relations.

item.title: 'Hoje é dia de jogo, nada nem ninguém me aborrece', diz Flávio Bolsonaro após ser alvo de Michelle em vídeo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said 'today is game day, nothing or nobody bothers me' during a YouTube live, following an Instagram video by Michelle Bolsonaro that mentioned him. He avoided commenting on the incident, focusing on football and mentioning a visit to former president Jair Bolsonaro, from whom he said he received a hug for everyone. He appeared alongside his wife wearing a Neymar mask.

item.title: 'Ele foi muito ríspido', 'me maltratou no telefone': veja FRASES do vídeo de Michelle sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accused her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro of publicly attacking her on social media after an event in Ceará, describing his conduct as a 'stab in the back' and saying he was rude and disrespectful in a subsequent phone call. She claimed the attacks were coordinated with his brothers and that she had tried to contact him privately before the public posts, without success.
